packages.title: my.mes Core Package
packages.shortDescription: Core resources for the my.mes system in the benchmark landscape.

agents.title: Production Quality Monitor Agent
agents.shortDescription: Autonomous agent that monitors quality inspection results and triggers corrective actions.
agents.description: This agent continuously monitors QualityInspection outcomes across active ProductionOrders and automatically detects quality deviations. When defect rates exceed thresholds, it initiates escalation workflows, recommends production order adjustments, and logs quality incidents for traceability. It reduces manual quality oversight and accelerates response to quality issues in real-time.

agents.title: Supplier Quality Compliance Orchestrator
agents.shortDescription: Automates vendor performance monitoring and procurement compliance validation.
agents.description: Monitors supplier quality metrics and vendor compliance status by coordinating across purchase orders and contracts. Processes incoming material inspections and automatically escalates non-conformance issues to designated vendors. Orchestrates quality certifications and supplier audit schedules to maintain manufacturing standards.

agents.title: Production Change Orchestrator
agents.shortDescription: Automates and coordinates engineering changes across production materials and items.
agents.description: Orchestrates the propagation of engineering changes throughout the production environment by monitoring change requests, automating impact assessments on materials and product items, and coordinating synchronized updates across dependent production workflows. Processes change notifications to ensure manufacturing execution systems remain synchronized with engineering modifications while maintaining asset lifecycle integrity.
useCases: Operations manager submits engineering change order for new product variant with material updates
Manufacturing execution system automates handoff between engineering changes and shop-floor implementation.
Manufacturing orchestrates production changes when new compliant materials are approved.
Production agent orchestrates real-time scheduling of machines, material kits, and work orders to implement the change without line disruption.
Production planner synchronizes material changes across manufacturing systems
Supply chain coordinator initiates bill-of-materials updates for product variants
Change management tracks impacts of material updates on production schedules.
Operations synchronizes engineering changes across equipment and processes.

agents.title: Bill of Materials Compliance Validator
agents.shortDescription: Automates BOM validation and supplier qualification checks across engineering changes.
agents.description: Monitors engineering changes and material specifications to automatically validate bill of materials compliance against supplier qualifications. Coordinates BOM updates with product item definitions while processing supplier approval workflows. Automates compliance verification across product variants to ensure manufacturing readiness and regulatory adherence.
useCases: Manufacturing confirms all components in the product structure meet material safety and engineering requirements.
Engineering change management ensures BOMs remain compliant when modifications occur.
Quality assurance validates material selections before production execution.

agents.title: Hazmat Incident Compliance Monitor
agents.shortDescription: Monitors hazardous substance incidents and coordinates supplier compliance responses.
agents.description: Continuously monitors hazardous substance handling and safety incidents across the production environment, automatically detecting compliance deviations and incident patterns. Coordinates incident notifications with suppliers, processes corrective actions, and automates hazmat-related compliance workflows to ensure regulatory adherence and safe material management throughout the procurement and production lifecycle.

apiResources.title: Equipment OEE Analytics API
apiResources.shortDescription: REST API for real-time machine performance metrics and OEE calculations.
apiResources.description: Exposes comprehensive OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) data for production machines, including availability, performance, and quality rates. Enables real-time dashboarding, historical trend analysis, and predictive maintenance insights by aggregating machine telemetry and production order execution data.

apiResources.title: Engineering Change & Product Item Integration API
apiResources.shortDescription: Exposes engineering changes and product items for production scheduling validation
apiResources.description: Provides access to engineering change records and product item data to enable real-time validation of production schedules against active design modifications. Retrieves current product configurations and change approvals to ensure manufacturing processes align with the latest engineering specifications and quality requirements.

apiResources.title: Service Ticket & Change Request Management API
apiResources.shortDescription: Manages and retrieves service tickets, change requests, and equipment maintenance records.
apiResources.description: Exposes endpoints to retrieve, create, and update service tickets and engineering change requests tied to manufacturing equipment. Provides access to maintenance workflows, change request status tracking, and equipment diagnostics correlation for compliance and supplier management purposes.
useCases: An IT technician receives a customer report of equipment failure and logs it as a service ticket for tracking.
Change management leadership gains real-time visibility into transition status across all functional teams.
IT and operational dependencies are tracked end-to-end through ticketing system to prevent implementation gaps.
Operations teams create formal change requests and service tickets to establish audit trail and task accountability for product transitions.
Change requests from engineering teams are centralized for impact analysis and approval workflows.

apiResources.title: Hazardous Substance Compliance Management API
apiResources.shortDescription: Manages and exposes hazardous substance inventory, compliance status, and regulatory documentation.
apiResources.description: This API retrieves and manages hazardous substance data across production facilities, providing real-time access to substance inventories, safety data sheets, compliance certifications, and regulatory reporting requirements. It enables downstream systems to obtain current hazmat information for quality inspections, equipment diagnostics, and audit trail maintenance.
useCases: Manufacturing facilities must maintain hazardous material inventories for regulatory inspection and employee safety

apiResources.title: Supplier Procurement Order Management
apiResources.shortDescription: Manages and retrieves purchase orders and vendor data for production material procurement.
apiResources.description: Exposes purchase order creation, retrieval, and status tracking capabilities integrated with vendor information. Provides access to supplier collaboration workflows, enabling manufacturing execution systems to coordinate procurement activities and manage vendor relationships. Retrieves and manages purchase order line items, delivery schedules, and vendor performance metrics for seamless supply chain integration.
useCases: Procurement specialists revise PO quantities and dates with vendors to synchronize material availability with the new production schedule.
Supply chain controllers ensure vendor-supplied materials align with modified production timelines and specifications.

apiResources.title: Workforce Schedule and Absence Management API
apiResources.shortDescription: Manages employee shift assignments and time-off requests in production operations.
apiResources.description: Exposes employee scheduling data and absence records to coordinate labor planning across manufacturing shifts. Retrieves time-off requests and employee availability to synchronize with production scheduling operations. Provides access to workforce capacity metrics for real-time production assignment optimization.

apiResources.title: Material and Vendor Inventory Management
apiResources.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages material stock levels and vendor supply chain data.
apiResources.description: Exposes real-time material inventory records and vendor information to support production scheduling and procurement workflows. Provides access to material availability, reorder points, and vendor performance metrics for optimized supply chain operations. Manages material-to-vendor relationships to ensure accurate sourcing and inventory replenishment across manufacturing facilities.
useCases: Supply chain team confirms material availability and vendor readiness for transition.
Procurement validates cost and timeline impact of material changes.
Manufacturing ensures component inventory supports new production requirements.

apiResources.title: Equipment Change and Service Management API
apiResources.shortDescription: Manages equipment changes, service requests, and maintenance governance.
apiResources.description: Exposes change requests, IT equipment records, and service tickets to coordinate equipment modifications and maintenance activities across the manufacturing facility. Retrieves approval workflows and risk assessments for equipment changes while managing service ticket lifecycle and equipment diagnostics integration.
useCases: IT Service Management ensures production equipment remains operational during peak order fulfillment.
Facility operations teams must plan and execute maintenance of safety systems that protect workers from identified hazardous substances
Operations teams prioritize critical equipment service requests affecting fulfillment SLAs.
Manufacturing facilities schedule preventive maintenance to minimize unplanned downtime.

apiResources.title: Campaign and Customer Order Management API
apiResources.shortDescription: Manages production campaigns and customer account orders within manufacturing execution workflows.
apiResources.description: Exposes campaign scheduling and customer account order data to coordinate production planning with customer demand. Provides access to campaign configurations, customer segmentation details, and order fulfillment tracking across the MES environment. Retrieves real-time campaign status and customer account information to support integrated order-to-production workflows.
useCases: Marketing launches coordinated customer campaigns announcing production transition.
Sales operations synchronize order management with transitioned product capabilities.
Customer service prepares for increased order volume during transition period.

apiResources.title: Hazardous Substance Inventory Management API
apiResources.shortDescription: Manages and provides access to hazardous substance inventory, handling, and compliance data.
apiResources.description: Exposes hazardous substance inventory records, retrieves material safety information, and manages compliance documentation across production facilities. Enables real-time tracking of hazardous material usage, storage locations, and regulatory exposure for manufacturing processes.

apiResources.title: Workforce Availability and Capacity API
apiResources.shortDescription: Retrieves employee availability and time-off data for production capacity planning.
apiResources.description: Exposes real-time employee availability and time-off schedules to support dynamic production capacity planning and workforce allocation decisions. Provides access to employee work patterns and absence data, enabling Sales operations to coordinate resource availability with customer order commitments and optimize labor utilization across production schedules.

apiResources.title: Equipment Service and Change Management API
apiResources.shortDescription: Manages equipment maintenance requests, change orders, and service tickets for production assets.
apiResources.description: This API exposes equipment-related service tickets, captures change requests for production line modifications, and retrieves diagnostic data from manufacturing equipment. It provides access to the complete lifecycle of equipment maintenance events, compliance documentation, and supplier service coordination across the production facility.
useCases: Change managers assess service impact of production transitions.
Maintenance teams check equipment service status before authorizing changes.
Maintenance coordinators document equipment service requirements and process configuration changes before production launch.
Operations identify cascading equipment dependencies across production lines.
Manufacturing operations teams verify production equipment is operational and configured to meet new product specifications.

apiResources.title: Equipment Change and Service Integration API
apiResources.shortDescription: Manages equipment changes, service requests, and diagnostics coordination.
apiResources.description: Exposes change requests, IT equipment configurations, and service tickets to coordinate equipment lifecycle management across the manufacturing execution system. Retrieves real-time equipment status, maintenance history, and change impact assessments. Provides access to integrated change workflows, equipment diagnostics data, and service scheduling for digital twin synchronization.

apiResources.title: Material and Vendor Master Data API
apiResources.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages material specifications and vendor information for production planning.
apiResources.description: This API exposes material master records and vendor data to support production scheduling and supply chain operations. It provides access to material attributes, vendor qualifications, and supply chain relationships that drive manufacturing execution decisions. The resource manages material classifications and vendor performance indicators used across production workflows.

apiResources.title: Customer Order and Account Management API
apiResources.shortDescription: Exposes customer accounts and orders for production scheduling and fulfillment tracking.
apiResources.description: This API provides access to customer account master data and production orders, enabling real-time retrieval of customer information and order status throughout the manufacturing execution lifecycle. The resource manages customer account hierarchies, order details, and fulfillment status to support production scheduling, quality inspection workflows, and OEE correlation analysis.

dataProducts.title: Production Order Quality Metrics
dataProducts.shortDescription: Aggregated quality performance and defect rates per production order.
dataProducts.description: This analytical data product aggregates quality inspection results and defect metrics across all production orders in real-time. It provides visibility into acceptance rates, rejection counts, and quality trends by order, enabling rapid identification of quality issues and root cause analysis for continuous improvement.

dataProducts.title: Production Labor Productivity Metrics
dataProducts.shortDescription: Aggregates employee compensation and performance data to analyze production labor efficiency.
dataProducts.description: Provides comprehensive metrics on labor productivity by synthesizing employee compensation records with production performance data. Summarizes key performance indicators including labor cost per unit produced, employee efficiency benchmarks, and compensation-to-output ratios across production shifts. Enables data-driven insights for workforce planning and labor cost optimization in manufacturing operations.

dataProducts.title: Engineering Change Impact Analytics
dataProducts.shortDescription: Aggregates cost, complexity, and supplier impact metrics from engineering changes and material modifications.
dataProducts.description: Synthesizes engineering change data with material specifications and product item configurations to provide comprehensive impact analysis. Summarizes bill-of-materials complexity, supplier dependency metrics, and compliance exposure across all active product modifications. Delivers actionable insights on change propagation costs and regulatory alignment for informed decision-making.

dataProducts.title: Incident and Safety Analytics
dataProducts.shortDescription: Aggregates incident and safety event data with compliance metrics and trend analysis.
dataProducts.description: This data product aggregates production incidents and safety incidents across manufacturing operations, providing comprehensive analytics on incident frequency, severity distribution, and safety compliance metrics. It summarizes incident patterns by equipment, location, and shift, enabling root cause identification and proactive safety risk mitigation to support continuous improvement in workplace safety performance.

dataProducts.title: Equipment Maintenance and Change Impact Analytics
dataProducts.shortDescription: Aggregates equipment diagnostics, maintenance requests, and configuration changes to optimize asset performance.
dataProducts.description: This data product summarizes maintenance tickets, equipment status, and change request impacts across the production floor. It provides metrics on equipment downtime, change approval workflows, and their correlation to service ticket resolution times, enabling data-driven maintenance prioritization and change management optimization.

dataProducts.title: Customer Order Fulfillment and OEE Correlation Analytics
dataProducts.shortDescription: Aggregates customer demand with equipment performance to optimize production scheduling and delivery commitments.
dataProducts.description: This data product synthesizes CustomerAccount order patterns and SalesOpportunity pipeline data with real-time OEE metrics to provide actionable insights on production capacity allocation and fulfillment risk. It summarizes delivery performance metrics, equipment utilization against customer commitments, and identifies bottlenecks impacting sales opportunity conversion. The product enables cross-functional visibility into how manufacturing efficiency directly influences customer satisfaction and revenue realization.

dataProducts.title: Supplier Performance and Procurement Optimization Analytics
dataProducts.shortDescription: Aggregates vendor reliability, contract compliance, and purchase order metrics for supply chain optimization.
dataProducts.description: Aggregates and summarizes supplier performance indicators across contracts, purchase orders, and vendor relationships to provide actionable metrics on delivery compliance, quality performance, and cost efficiency. Provides comprehensive analytics on procurement patterns, vendor reliability trends, and contract fulfillment to support strategic sourcing decisions and supply chain risk mitigation in manufacturing execution.

dataProducts.title: Employee Compensation and Safety Risk Correlation Analytics
dataProducts.shortDescription: Aggregates compensation patterns and safety incident data to identify risk correlations.
dataProducts.description: This data product synthesizes employee compensation structures with safety incident records to provide metrics on occupational risk exposure and its relationship to workforce compensation models. It summarizes safety performance indicators across employee segments, enabling identification of high-risk roles and their corresponding compensation implications for proactive risk management and policy optimization.

dataProducts.title: Material Cost and Invoice Reconciliation Analytics
dataProducts.shortDescription: Aggregates material consumption and supplier invoicing data to optimize procurement ROI.
dataProducts.description: This dataProduct synthesizes Material entity consumption patterns with Invoice records to provide comprehensive financial analytics on procurement efficiency. It summarizes cost variances, supplier performance metrics, and material usage trends to support customer monetization strategies and campaign ROI optimization. The analytics enable identification of cost reduction opportunities and invoice accuracy validation across production operations.
